description: This file defines the main entry point of a SwiftUI application named SecureSessionApp. It sets up environment objects for session management and app locking, and specifies the root view of the application's UI.

classes.name: SecureSessionApp
classes.description: The main application struct conforming to the App protocol, responsible for initializing the app's scene and environment objects.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the scene with a window group containing the root view, injecting environment objects for session and lock management.
